body:
Investigated SHANKPIT/REDGARDEN/ECOWAR/BRAWLPIT/PAPERCRAFT/WEAKNIGHT_BEDROCK_RACERS/GoblinFoxDragon directly (md5 diffs, line diffs, not assumed) rather than guessing. Real findings: SHANKPIT/GFD are a genuinely different Go-server lineage, never structurally 'the engine' for the C/SDL2 arena games; mat4.h byte-identical in 3 repos (one not even a fork); hmac_sha256.h/http_client.h copied then silently diverged; a live example from this same session (S370's ECOWAR-only matchmaker fix already left REDGARDEN's copy behind); draw_login_screen is a near-line-for-line hand-copy between PAPERCRAFT and WEAKNIGHT. Credited real existing progress (stdlib/sdl2.prn, per-game stdlib namespaces) and named the real architectural distinction between PARENA-compiles-logic-for-a-host (existing pattern) vs PARENA-owns-the-host (this ask) as needing its own design pass. Proposed PARENA/stdlib/engine/ namespace with a 5-phase plan starting from zero-controversy extractions, DEADWEIGHT named as the real first net_snapshot.prn consumer. EMILY d9da80c2, DEADWEIGHT 3748e68 (cross-link). No code written yet.
